use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use vize_atelier_core::{CodegenOptions, options::CustomElementMatcher};
use vize_atelier_sfc::{SfcCompileExperimentalOptions, SfcCompileOptions, SfcParseOptions};
use vize_l0::String;

use super::options;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum Profile {
    SeparateTemplateAuthoredRenderBinding,
    DualScriptInlineTypeOnlyImports,
    ImportedComponentBeforeProp,
    DynamicLoopRefFor,
    ComputedComponentUnref,
    CustomDirectiveChildPatch,
    ScopedCssVBind,
    StructuredSfcSourceMap,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Request {
    pub schema: u16,
    pub profile: Profile,
    pub source: String,
    pub configuration: Value,
}

pub struct Validated {
    pub request: Request,
    pub descriptor: SfcParseOptions,
    pub compile: SfcCompileOptions,
    pub codegen: CodegenOptions,
    pub custom_elements: CustomElementMatcher,
    pub experimental: SfcCompileExperimentalOptions,
}

impl Profile {
    fn source(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::SeparateTemplateAuthoredRenderBinding => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/separate-template-authored-render-binding/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::DualScriptInlineTypeOnlyImports => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/dual-script-inline-type-only-imports/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::ImportedComponentBeforeProp => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/imported-component-before-prop/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::DynamicLoopRefFor => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/dynamic-loop-ref-for/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::ComputedComponentUnref => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/computed-component-unref/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::CustomDirectiveChildPatch => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/custom-directive-child-patch/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::ScopedCssVBind => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/scoped-css-v-bind/App.vue"
            ),
            Self::StructuredSfcSourceMap => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/structured-sfc-source-map/App.vue"
            ),
        }
    }

    fn configuration(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::SeparateTemplateAuthoredRenderBinding => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/separate-template-authored-render-binding/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::DualScriptInlineTypeOnlyImports => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/dual-script-inline-type-only-imports/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::ImportedComponentBeforeProp => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/imported-component-before-prop/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::DynamicLoopRefFor => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/dynamic-loop-ref-for/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::ComputedComponentUnref => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/computed-component-unref/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::CustomDirectiveChildPatch => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/custom-directive-child-patch/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::ScopedCssVBind => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/scoped-css-v-bind/fixture-options.json"
            ),
            Self::StructuredSfcSourceMap => include_str!(
                "../../../../tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/structured-sfc-source-map/fixture-options.json"
            ),
        }
    }
}

pub fn validate(request: Request) -> Result<Validated, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    if request.schema != 1 || request.source.len() > 1024 * 1024 {
        return Err("unsupported compiler observer schema or source bound".into());
    }
    let pinned: Value = serde_json::from_str(request.profile.configuration())?;
    if request.configuration != pinned {
        return Err("compiler fixture configuration differs from the pinned profile".into());
    }
    if request.source.as_str() != request.profile.source() {
        return Err("compiler observer source differs from the authored fixture".into());
    }
    let mut descriptor = SfcParseOptions::default();
    let mut compile = SfcCompileOptions::default();
    let mut codegen = CodegenOptions::default();
    match request.profile {
        Profile::SeparateTemplateAuthoredRenderBinding => {
            compile.parse.filename = "Foo.vue".into();
        }
        Profile::ImportedComponentBeforeProp => {
            compile.script.is_ts = true;
            compile.script.inline_template = false;
        }
        Profile::DynamicLoopRefFor => {
            descriptor.filename = "CascaderPanel.vue".into();
            compile.script.inline_template = false;
        }
        Profile::ScopedCssVBind => {
            compile.scope_id = Some("test".into());
            compile.script.id = Some("src/Box.vue".into());
        }
        Profile::StructuredSfcSourceMap => {
            descriptor.filename = "/app/src/Fixture.vue".into();
            compile.parse.filename = "/app/src/Fixture.vue".into();
            compile.script.id = Some("/app/src/Fixture.vue".into());
            compile.script.inline_template = false;
            codegen.source_map = true;
        }
        Profile::DualScriptInlineTypeOnlyImports
        | Profile::ComputedComponentUnref
        | Profile::CustomDirectiveChildPatch => {}
    }
    let custom_elements = CustomElementMatcher::default();
    let experimental = SfcCompileExperimentalOptions::default();
    if experimental.self_component {
        return Err("compiler observer experimental defaults changed".into());
    }
    options::validate(&pinned, &descriptor, &compile, &codegen, &custom_elements)?;
    Ok(Validated {
        request,
        descriptor,
        compile,
        codegen,
        custom_elements,
        experimental,
    })
}
